d:
I LOVE ADELE. I mean, who doesn't? She is THE queen. This is one of my favorite songs of hers and I've had this mashup idea since "25" came out. Jashn E Bahaara is one of my (and my grandma's) favorite songs from Jodhaa Akbar, although every song in that movie is amazing. Did a simple one take, jam style video in our studio. What do you guys think?
Huge thanks to Shankar Tucker for the music production & Jomy George for playing tabla & percussion!
